Docs/Connectors

Connectors

A connector is a bundle of tools for one job, like Calendar or YouTube Downloads. There are 20 connectors with 95 tools in all. A fresh install switches on the everyday ones and leaves the rest off until you add them.

Essentials

Everyday phone info and controls. Nothing here reads your personal data.

  • Device infoBattery, storage, network, time and more.9 tools
  • Device controlsFlashlight, volume, brightness and phone modes.13 tools
  • Alarms & timersSet alarms and timers.7 tools
  • RemindersGet reminded at a time, with a sound.4 tools
  • Apps & settingsOpen apps and settings, use the clipboard.10 tools
  • WeatherWeather now and for the next few days.1 tool

Search and media

Web search, web pages, YouTube and pictures.

  • Web searchSearch the web.1 tool
  • Web pagesRead any web page or link.1 tool
  • YouTube SearchSearch YouTube videos and playlists.4 tools
  • YouTube DownloadsSave YouTube videos or audio to your phone.2 tools
  • PicturesShow pictures you saved in Ultron, or photos from your phone.1 tool

Personal data

Reads private data from your phone, such as contacts, calendar, location, files and notifications. What you ask about is sent to Gemini.

  • CalendarCheck your schedule and add events.4 tools
  • ContactsFind contacts, birthdays and save new contacts.3 tools
  • CallsCall a contact by name.1 tool
  • LocationKnow where you are and get directions.2 tools
  • FilesBrowse folders, find any file and open it.4 tools
  • App usageSee which apps you use most.2 tools
  • NotificationsRead and reply to notifications.4 tools

Phone control

Lets Ultron operate other apps through Android accessibility. It can tap, type and read the screen, so turn it on only if you understand that.

  • Phone navigationGo back, go home, scroll and take screenshots.11 tools
  • Screen controlRead the screen, tap and type.11 tools
